title: Header counts are exact and the same in List, Tech View and Board View
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. On the Work Orders QA build, seed a KNOWN set of work orders across statuses (some Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, and some in excluded statuses) and across several lead technicians, so the header counts and the N-open dialog count can be computed by hand (Rule 14, Rule 116).
  4. A location where each technician's matching work-order count can be computed by hand from List, under a fixed filter.
custom_steps:
1. Under a fixed filter, count each technician's matching work orders by hand in List.
  2. Open Tech View; confirm each group header count equals your hand count.
  3. Open Board View; confirm each column header count equals the same number.
  4. Confirm the Unassigned count equals the hand-counted work orders with no lead technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each group header shows the technician's name, avatar, and the count of matching work orders.
  • Each column header shows the technician's name, avatar, and the count of matching work orders.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10043 — DATA. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S2-R12, S3-R12 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R12: “Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.”
  • S3-R12: “Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.”
